line.name: Santa Clara 1830 50th Anniversary Triple Maduro (also marketed as "Medio Siglo Triple Maduro")
line.description: Not on the site. A limited 50th-anniversary release. The Mac folder has the manufacturer's own official Vitolario charts for two apparently related products - one banded/marketed in English ('50th Anniversary Triple Maduro') and one in Spanish ('Medio Siglo Triple Maduro' - literally 'Half Century') - both showing identical vitolas (Robusto 5x50, Toro 6x50) and identical 'Triple Maduro' positioning. FLAG: treating these as the same release marketed under two names/bands (likely for different markets) rather than two distinct products, since I found no evidence of a meaningful difference beyond band language - but this is an inference from the chart imagery, not independently confirmed via a third-party source. Recommend verifying if you have more context on how these two bandings were distributed.
